round: relevance-filtering research round 14 (zukhruf #3383, limitation 16): does d1's lead over desc+kw hold when a second AI family writes fresh-5's answer key?
writtenBefore: any label from the second annotator family exists. Rounds 12 and 13 are scored and known; this round chooses no design, it tests one fixed claim of round 13.
why: fresh-5's answer key comes from Claude (Opus 5.5) annotators, and d1 is also a language model; labels from a language model can prefer a language-model ranker (Faggioli et al., ICTIR 2023; Clarke and Dietz 2024). On 2026-10-30 the user chose 'Another AI family labels first' before the Scorer port is built. A second family removes a bias of one family, not a bias of language-model labels in general.
annotators: OpenAI Codex CLI (codex exec 0.164.0 with --ignore-user-config --ephemeral -s workspace-write, no --model, so the ChatGPT account's default model; the model name is recorded from each run's event log), one per fresh-5 queue 1..4, blind. Brief: the fresh-5 brief word for word, with two changes only: the paths point to round-14/annotate/, and the blind rule reads 'do not open, list or search any file outside $P, and no labels file of another queue'. round-14/annotate/ holds only copies of profiles.md, profiles.json, tools/*.py, fresh-5/queue-1..4.json and fresh-5/items.json, each checked byte-equal to its original by sha256.
labels: round-14/annotate/labels-gpt-N.jsonl, merged by round-14/merge.py to round-14/labels-gpt.json (one row per fresh-5 article) and frozen before any round-14 score. A queue that a run leaves incomplete is resumed with the same brief (check.py first, no relabel).
claim: d1 (round 13's chosen ranker; frozen answers a86a1235...) against desc+kw (the frozen ranker), on the GPT labels.
metrics: Round 13's, unchanged, with only the test labels replaced: MAP over profiles with >= 20 strict relevant GPT-labelled fresh-5 articles; daily recall over profiles with >= 20 days that hold a strict relevant GPT-labelled article; T11F of p_d1 >= 0.5 against keywordNarrow and Brier skill (reported). Teaching pool and its labels unchanged (collection, fresh, fresh-2, fresh-3, fresh-4).
pass: Topic-level paired bootstrap, 2000 replicates, numpy.random.default_rng(31967). HOLDS when d1's MAP interval against desc+kw lies entirely above 0 and its daily-recall interval against desc+kw has lower bound > -0.05. Otherwise DOES NOT HOLD.
reported: Per profile, Claude (fresh-5/labels.json) against GPT on all 1,370 articles: Cohen's kappa strict (relevant vs not) and ambiguous-as-relevant, true-vs-null and true-vs-false counts (agreement/agreement.py's definitions). MAP and daily recall of every round-13 list on the GPT labels.
check: Before any GPT label exists, evaluate.py --claude runs on fresh-5/labels.json with round 13's seed and must equal round-13/results.json (macro MAP, daily recall, every interval, the decision block) to 1e-12.
then: HOLDS: the Scorer design goes ahead with d1; the user decides its shape. DOES NOT HOLD: d1's lead depends on the annotator family; the result goes to #3383 and the research record, and the package does not change before the user decides.
